title: I&P GN - SC&E – Senior Manager - S&P - Indirect Analysis
description:
**Senior Solution Architect (7\+ Years)**

**Architect scalable, secure and cost\-effective enterprise solutions**

**Experience:** 7\+ years in software engineering, with significant solution/technical architecture experience

**Management Level:** 8/9

**Location:** Gurugram

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Educational Qualification:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

**ROLE SUMMARY**


We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the design of scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions across cloud and enterprise systems. Acting as the bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, you will translate requirements into robust architecture blueprints, define technical standards, and guide delivery teams from design through production. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands\-on depth; you will make high\-impact technology decisions, champion best practices, and ensure solutions meet demanding non\-functional requirements around performance, security, resilience, and cost.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define end\-to\-end solution architectures that align with business goals, enterprise standards, and long\-term technology strategy.
* Translate business and functional requirements into clear technical designs, high\-level and low\-level design documents, and architecture blueprints.
* Evaluate, recommend, and select technologies, frameworks, and platforms, including build\-vs\-buy and cloud\-provider decisions.
* Design cloud\-native, microservices, event\-driven, and API\-first architectures for scalability and maintainability.
* Define and govern non\-functional requirements \- scalability, performance, availability, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, establish coding and design standards, and drive technical governance across teams.
* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, security, and infrastructure teams; present architecture and trade\-offs to senior leadership and clients.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, unblocking complex engineering challenges.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept and prototypes to validate architectural approaches and de\-risk delivery.
* Embed security and compliance by design across the solution lifecycle.
* Champion DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code adoption to improve delivery speed and quality.
* Operate within Agile/Scrum delivery models, contributing to estimation, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* 7\+ years in software engineering, including proven experience in a solution, technical, or application architect capacity.
* Demonstrated track record designing and delivering large\-scale, distributed, production systems.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong command of microservices, API design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* A solid engineering foundation with hands\-on coding experience in one or more major languages (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, Node.js).
* Strong understanding of application/data security, DevOps practices, and system integration.
* Demonstrated experience delivering solutions in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE\-TO\-HAVE)**

* Experience in Data Engineering \- designing data pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, streaming, and big\-data platforms (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Recognized architecture certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF).
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar.
* Experience with event\-driven and streaming architectures at scale.
* Domain experience in analytics, data\-intensive, or large enterprise product environments.
* Pre\-sales or consulting exposure, including solution shaping and effort estimation.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* **Architecture:** Microservices, event\-driven, API\-first, domain\-driven design, integration patterns, EA frameworks (e.g., TOGAF)
* **Cloud:** AWS / Azure / GCP, serverless, containers (Kubernetes), Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* **Development:** Java, .NET, Python, or Node.js; REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* **Data \& Messaging:** SQL \& NoSQL, data modelling, caching, messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* **Security:** IAM, OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC, encryption, zero\-trust and secure\-by\-design principles
* **DevOps \& Modelling:** CI/CD, observability, SRE practices; UML and C4 architecture modelling

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Technical leadership and the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strategic thinking balanced with pragmatic, hands\-on execution.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management across business and technology.
* Confident decision\-making under ambiguity and competing constraints.
* Mentorship and a genuine commitment to growing engineering talent.
* Strong facilitation and negotiation skills across cross\-functional teams.

title: Cyber Security/Network Security Solution Architect
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Job Description**
-------------------


* Eexperience range: **12\+ years**; location: **Gurgaon**.
* Key technologies identified for sourcing:
* + **Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet**
	+ **Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar**
	+ **Ansible, Terraform, Python** (good to have)
	+ **AWS/Azure**

title: Junior Network Planner
description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Network Planning


**Recruiter:** Tanu Jagnani

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



We're looking for a motivated Junior Manager Operational Planning in Gurugram who will help us drive the India business to the next level and have the most direct influence on our success.  

The network planning team is the chief architect of our business. The network planning team has a strategic role to play in working closely with the managing director, the commercial functions as well as the business development to decide the initial network, allocate the right supply and then handle the marketplace to create further efficiencies

  

**About the Role**


* Lead network launches by driving planning, execution, and successful handovers to internal stakeholders.
* Track and analyse network performance using data to understand trends and make better decisions.
* Improve and optimise routes, frequencies, and schedules to make the network more efficient and profitable.
* Plan our FlixBus lines in collaboration with our business partners, revenue management, and our experienced local teams to develop our network.
* Coordinate the interactions on your allocated line portfolio with the other teams to ensure smooth processes (e.g. line starts and operational requests).
* Base your decisions on quantitative analyses and derive conclusions and observations from a variety of data sets to make informed decisions.
* Be a driving force in the expansion of FlixBus in India, shaping the future of transportation with innovation and enthusiasm.


**About You**


* Master’s degree in economics, Urban Planning, Geographical Engineering, Transportation, or a related field.
* Has 1\-2 years of experience in network planning, transportation planning from mobility/travel or related industry, preferably within a global setup.
* Demonstrates a strong understanding of India’s geography and travel demand patterns.
* Possesses strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, derive insights, and make informed decisions.
* Brings solid business acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset to drive network growth and profitability.
* Proficient in using planning software, Power BI, Excel, Cubes, and other network planning tools.
* Speaks and writes fluent English and excels at cross\-functional coordination with multiple stakeholders across regions.


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Edge
description:
About Role
Senior Lead Engineer \- Edge
REA •
Gurgaon, IN •
10 \- 13 years •
Full\-Time
Role Summary**REA Group in India:**


You might already recognize our logo. The REA brand does have an existing presence in India. In fact, we set up our new tech hub in Gurugram to be their neighbours!


REA Group holds a controlling interest in REA India Pte. Ltd., operator of established brands Housing.com, Makaan.com and PropTiger.com, three of the country’s leading digital property marketplaces.


Through our close connection to REA India, we’ve seen first\-hand the incredible talent the country has to offer, and the huge opportunity to expand our global workforce. Our Cyber City Tech Center is an extension of REA Group; a satellite office working directly with our Australia HQ on local projects and tech delivery.


All our brands, across the globe, connect regularly, learn from each other and collaborate on shared value initiatives.


Location
Gurgaon
Experience Range
10 \- 13 years
Must\-have Skills
CDN or WAF
Python or GoLang or Bash or Shell or Scripting
Akamai or Kasada
About REA
At REA, we are shaping the future of real estate. Our engineering teams are the architects behind the experiences that millions of property seekers rely on every day. We use the latest technology to deliver best\-in\-class experiences to our customers.



Job Description**About REA Group:**


In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property?”


Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never.


Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that ‘day one’ mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future.


Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group’s global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We’re looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey.


If you’re excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on.

**What the role is all about:**


We’re seeking a Staff Engineer \- EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well\-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.


You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved\-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.


This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer\-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.


**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities.
* Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self\-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end\-to\-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet\-facing systems.
* Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one\-off solutions.
* Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on\-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models.
* Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams.
* Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centred on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 9\+ years’ experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands\-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments.
* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade\-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet\-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high\-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self\-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high\-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick\-up and drop\-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health \& wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**


Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**


We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking \- be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Embark on a transformative journey as an Infrastructure Engineer at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


The Salesforce COE Team was setup in March 2013 with an objective to provide support to the Corporate Banking, Barclaycard and Business Banking colleagues. The team offers user support, project management and CRM adoption / ad\-hoc analytics to all the three Salesforce business segments


To be successful in this role as an Infrastructure Engineer, you should possess the following skillsets:


Person Specification:


**Technical Skills/Competencies**


* Attention to detail and quality of output
* MS Office applications
* Communication skills
* Ability to synthesise and summarise information concisely
* Ability to speak internationally with ease
* Team work
* Enjoys working in cross functional and multi\-national teams
* Ability to drive own performance and achieve results
* Take responsibility for own personal development

 **Knowledge \& Expertise**


* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word and Power Point)
* Ability to translate written instructions into action items
* Aptitude to work in a variable business environment, periodically requiring tight deadlines and aggressive turn\-around times
* Strong business acumen
* Knowledge and understanding of the financial services industry, in particular commercial or investment banking, is preferable

**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:**


* Relevant years of prior experience in Salesforce.com technologies
* Certified Salesforce Administrator
* Stake holder management skills
* Project management skills

**Some other highly valued skills include:**


* Sales Cloud Certification
* Service Cloud Certification
* Einstein Analytics Certification

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based in our Gurgaon office.


**Purpose of the role**


To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.


**Accountabilities**


* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
